decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's established reissue and compilation know-how, so management can interpret its early sales and keep it in the catalog at little cost, even though the firm does no R&D of its own and genre fit with its niche audience is uncertain.

The illustrated release series builds directly on the label's long experience with carefully produced curated editions, giving the firm the related knowledge to assimilate feedback and develop the line further.
